checks.why: the JavaScript engine resolves a handler passed to app.get(…) to an edge, so the answer said only 'calls it' and never that the declaration being changed is GET /pads — the edge is the engine's, the sentence is the registration's

a callback that is not a route is NOT relabelled as one: this rule renames only what it can prove is a route, and `setTimeout(auditLog, 1000)` is not. It keeps the engine's own reading of the edge — which, since #1131, is the hand-off the tier actually records. It said 'calls it' before, and setTimeout does not call auditLog: it is handed the function and runs it later
